final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out * out <= n
  post n // (out + 1) < out + 1
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(15) == 3
  ex isqrt(16) == 4
  var lo = 0
  var hi = 3037000499
  if n < hi
    hi = n
  while lo < hi
    let mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
    if mid <= n // mid
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid - 1
  lo

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(26) == 5
